notes: BACKLOG B-80. Drowsing Tyrannodon: 'Defender. As long as you control a creature with power 4 or greater, this creature can attack as though it didn't have defender.' An 'as though' effect (CR 609.4) lifts only the restriction on attacking (CR 702.3b): with the 4-power Blood Glutton in play the Tyrannodon still has defender, so Portcullis Vine's '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice a creature with defender: Draw a card' may sacrifice it (the cost designation is answered with its key). Before the fix the static compiled to LOSE_ABILITY(DEFENDER): the Tyrannodon stopped having defender, the sacrifice menu offered only the Vine, and this pack failed.
